_doc: Registry shown in the About panel. statusKey names a source in data/health.json (scheduled) or a live source tracked in the browser; entries without one are bundled or curated.

sources.name: World Bank WDI
sources.provides: GDP growth, inflation, official birr rate, reserves, external debt, population, remittances, FDI; neighbour comparison
sources.cadence: Daily job; the data itself is annual and lags 1-2 years

sources.name: IMF World Economic Outlook
sources.provides: Alternative GDP growth and inflation values shown in detail cards (never projections)

sources.name: World Bank International Debt Statistics
sources.provides: External debt by creditor type and named creditor, debt ratios

sources.name: World Bank (all countries)
sources.provides: GDP, population and growth for every country in the relations panel

sources.name: World Bank Pink Sheet
sources.provides: Coffee, gold and crude oil monthly prices
sources.cadence: Daily job; the source updates monthly

sources.name: Open-Meteo
sources.provides: Current weather and 7-day forecast for 8 cities
sources.cadence: Live, every 15 minutes, in your browser

sources.name: USGS Earthquakes
sources.provides: Earthquakes (M2.5+) in the Horn of Africa and Rift
sources.cadence: Live, every 10 minutes, in your browser

sources.name: IMF PortWatch
sources.provides: Daily ship transits through Bab el-Mandeb and Suez

sources.name: GDELT
sources.provides: News headlines about Ethiopia's economy and infrastructure
sources.cadence: Daily job; rate-limited, so often unavailable

sources.name: Ethiopian outlet RSS feeds
sources.provides: Headlines and links from Capital Ethiopia, The Reporter and Addis Fortune (topic-filtered)

sources.name: UN Comtrade
sources.provides: Trade by partner and commodity; bilateral trade in country profiles
sources.cadence: Daily job; data lags months to years

sources.name: HDX (HAPI)
sources.provides: People in need, food insecurity (IPC), staple food prices
sources.cadence: Daily job; many series update monthly or less

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.provides: Country boundaries, lakes and disputed areas for the map

sources.name: Curated records
sources.provides: Infrastructure projects, relations profiles, bloc membership, IMF-programme and event timelines
sources.cadence: Hand-maintained, reviewed monthly; each record carries a last-verified date and source links
